description: Java source code for the DeviceRegistrationApiResource class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing device registrations in the Fineract platform.

classes.name: DeviceRegistrationApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for device registration management, handling CRUD operations via HTTP methods.

methods.name: registerDevice
methods.description: Handles POST request to register a new device, parsing JSON input and returning the device ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllDeviceRegistrations
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve all device registrations.

methods.name: retrieveDeviceRegistrationByClientId
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve device registration data for a specific client ID.

methods.name: retrieveDeviceRegiistration
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a device registration by its ID.

methods.name: updateDeviceRegistration
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing device registration.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a device registration by ID.

methods.name: responseMap
methods.description: Creates a JSON response containing the resource ID after deletion.
